bio.title: Passionate about the beauty of my native land
bio.paragraph1: Specialist of the northern region of Madagascar, I show the wonders of my island to travelers from around the world.
bio.paragraph2: My goal is to offer you an authentic and custom experience, far from industrial tourist circuits. I know every corner of Diego-Suarez and Nosy Be, and I will be delighted to share with you my secret places and our warm culture.
bio.paragraph3: Whether you are passionate about biodiversity, paradise beaches, spectacular hikes or cultural encounters, I adapt each itinerary to your desires.

hero.title: Diego-Suarez Province
hero.subtitle: The pearl of northern Madagascar — Antsiranana

about.title: About Diego-Suarez
about.paragraph1: Diego-Suarez, now called Antsiranana, is a spectacular coastal city located at the extreme north of Madagascar. It is world-renowned for housing one of the most beautiful bays in the world.
about.paragraph2: Discover a region with unique wild landscapes: crystal-clear bays, isolated beaches, preserved national parks, spectacular tsingy and exceptional biodiversity.

beaches.carousel_description: From crystal-clear lagoons to white sand beaches, explore the most beautiful corners of the coast

hiking.title: Viewpoints, Hiking & Curiosities

history.title: History, City & Urbanism
history.carousel_description: Colonial architecture, tropical gardens and cultural richness

hero.title: Nosy Be Archipelago
hero.subtitle: The perfumed island and its tropical wonders

about.title: About Nosy Be
about.paragraph1: Nosy Be is Madagascar's flagship seaside destination. Nicknamed the « perfumed island » for its captivating scents of ylang-ylang and vanilla, it offers an idyllic setting.
about.paragraph2: Discover an archipelago with turquoise waters, populated with preserved islets, coral sandbanks, dense natural reserves and fascinating marine fauna.

journey.title: A great adventure starts with a conversation.

step1.title: Share your ideas
step1.text: Destinations, possible dates and group size: tell me about the trip you have in mind.

step2.title: Shape your itinerary
step2.text: Together we discuss stops, activities, transport and the services you need.

step3.title: Travel with confidence
step3.text: We agree on the itinerary and arrangements before confirming your trip.

faq.title: A few answers to get started.
faq.subtitle: Have something specific in mind? Let’s talk.
faq.a1: Yes. Share your interests, pace, group size and budget so we can prepare a suitable proposal.
faq.q2: Can I combine Diégo-Suarez and Nosy Be?
faq.a2: You can request a trip combining both destinations. We will agree on stops and transfers based on your available time.
faq.q3: How do I get a quote?
faq.a3: Send your dates, destinations and group size. Your proposal will detail included services, options and the price to agree before booking.
faq.q4: Does the form confirm my booking?
faq.a4: No. The form starts a conversation. A booking is confirmed after agreement on the itinerary, availability and arrangements.

privacy.title: Privacy & data
privacy.text1: The form sends your name, email address and message, along with any travel information you provide, to FormSubmit, the service used to deliver inquiries.
privacy.text2: The website saves your language and theme in your browser’s local storage. You can remove these preferences in your browser settings.
privacy.text3: The map uses Google Maps. Fonts and some icons load from external services. WhatsApp links open a third-party service. For questions about the information in your inquiry, contact us by email.

terms.title: Travel inquiry information
terms.text1: This site presents destinations and services. Sending a form or WhatsApp message does not confirm a booking.
terms.text2: Agree on the itinerary, dates, availability, price and included services directly with your guide before confirmation.
terms.text3: Ask about the payment, amendment and cancellation arrangements for your proposal before confirming. Excursions and their organization depend on local conditions.
